summary: Create or configure a message queue
description: The first active backend to configure a tenant-wide name becomes its owner. Only the owner can replace the policy. Omitted lists are empty. Explicit app allowlists and live invoke grants for selected owner capability versions are evaluated independently for producers and consumers. The owner can send, consume and manage dead letters. The attempt limit applies to new and replayed messages.

summary: Send a job to a queue
description: The compact UTF-8 JSON payload can occupy up to 65536 bytes. The request envelope can occupy up to 66560 bytes. A UUID idempotency key is scoped to the producer app and queue. Repeating the same payload and delay returns the original message ID, including after acknowledgement. A different payload or delay with the same key conflicts.

headerParameters.name: Idempotency-Key
headerParameters.description: UUID scoped to the queue and producer app.

description: Poll for at most one job. The lease increments its attempt count and returns a fresh token. An expired lease becomes available again unless it was the final attempt, in which case the message moves to dead letters. The response message is null when no job can be leased.
Only the app holding the current, unexpired lease may acknowledge this message. The completed payload is removed and the idempotency receipt remains.

summary: Retry or dead-letter a leased job
description: Only the app holding the current, unexpired lease may reject this message. The retry delay is 2^(attempt - 1) seconds. A rejection on the final attempt makes the message immediately visible in dead letters.
Only the queue owner can view dead letters. Results are ordered by message UUID. Pass nextCursor as cursor to continue. A replay removes the message from this list.
Only the queue owner may replay a dead letter. It becomes available immediately with the same message ID and payload, a reset attempt count and the current queue attempt limit.

Create or replace the calling app's schema and index configuration. All configured fields are declared top-level properties; uniqueKey, when set, is a required indexed string matching ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}$ on every record. Core validates writes to registered collections and maintains typed field values in shared expression indexes. Existing incompatible records or duplicate values return 409 before activation. An omitted auditActions retains the app-wide catalog; a supplied array replaces it and action names must be unique. The response includes the effective catalog. Unregistered collections retain schemaless writes.

summary: Read a collection field masking policy
description: Return the calling app’s policy for top-level record fields. A collection without a policy returns an empty fields object.

summary: Replace a collection field masking policy
description: Replace the complete policy for the calling app’s collection. Requires the owning backend with core-writer or a verified app manager with write access. An empty fields object clears the policy. Core masks fields for readers without a matching owner, role or exact-app share rule and audits clear disclosures. Masked fields are excluded from filter, sort, group, search and increment operations. A masking rule on the unique key returns 409.

summary: Count, sum, average or group records
description: Aggregate readable matching records in the selected owner scope. Use exactly one of count, sum or avg. Count includes all readable matching records. Numeric aggregates ignore missing and null values and return null if no numeric values match. Group keys are ordered by the request dimensions. Masked fields and sensitive fields hidden from management viewers cannot be used. Queries with more than 1,000 groups return 400 invalid_query. Source describes the same filters and UTC bounds for use in a list request.

queryParameters.name: groupBy
queryParameters.description: Repeat groupBy once per dimension. day(field) buckets an indexed date or date-time by UTC day.

queryParameters.name: where
queryParameters.description: One condition per indexed top-level field, combined with AND. Operands are JSON scalars (eq), nonempty JSON arrays of scalars (in), ordered JSON numbers/strings (gte/lte) or JSON strings (prefix). Field types must match the schema. Percent-encode query values.

queryParameters.name: ownerAppId
queryParameters.description: Defaults to the calling app. Another app's collection yields only records explicitly shared with the caller, including live app-group shares with current membership.

queryParameters.name: createdFrom
queryParameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on system created_at. Converted to UTC. Millisecond precision.

queryParameters.name: createdTo
queryParameters.description: Exclusive upper bound on system created_at. Converted to UTC. Millisecond precision.

queryParameters.name: sum
queryParameters.description: Indexed number or integer field for the aggregate.

queryParameters.name: avg
queryParameters.description: Indexed number or integer field for the aggregate.

summary: Upsert a record by its unique key
description: The collection must declare a uniqueKey and data must contain the exact case-sensitive path value. Creating a record returns 201 and may omit If-Match. Replacing an existing record returns 200 and requires If-Match, including while holding its lock. An If-Match for a key with no matching record version returns 412. A lock held by a different caller prevents replacement. Replay the same key, body and precondition to recover the original result.

headerParameters.name: Idempotency-Key
headerParameters.description: Required UUID for this write. A missing or malformed key returns 400 invalid_request. Core retains the first recorded result for 24 hours, scoped to the verified tenant and caller, HTTP method and concrete request path. Within that window, the same key and logical request replay the first status, body and resource headers without another write. A changed body or write precondition for the same key returns 422 idempotency_key_reused. Concurrent identical requests share one result; every replay requires current authorization.

headerParameters.name: If-Match
headerParameters.description: Send the exact strong ETag from the record response. Required when the request replaces existing data. Atomic increments and creation by unique key may omit it. If supplied, a missing or stale record version returns 412.

description: Apply 1–50 creates, replacements, deletions or atomic increment operations in request order in one transaction for the calling app. Every replace and delete requires ifMatch with the current record ETag, even for a schemaless collection or its lock holder. Each increment item applies one or more increments to one record using the atomic PATCH rules and may omit ifMatch. The batch key covers all items. Locks held by other callers block edits and deletes, including increments. Each result matches its input position. Deletes have version null. A failure rolls back the entire batch. Schema violation paths identify record data at /operations/N/data, including the resulting data of increments.

headerParameters.name: Idempotency-Key
headerParameters.description: Required UUID for this write. A missing or malformed key returns 400 invalid_request. Core retains the first recorded result for 24 hours, scoped to the verified tenant and caller, HTTP method and concrete request path. Within that window, the same key and logical request replay the first status, body and resource headers without another write. A changed body or write precondition for the same key returns 422 idempotency_key_reused. Concurrent identical requests share one result; every replay requires current authorization.

summary: Export records owned by the calling app
description: Active app owner only. The export covers record IDs and data across its collections. Collection definitions, record revisions, shares, file bytes and audit rows are outside this format. Core applies each collection’s field masking policy when it returns the export page.

Create the supplied records under the verified calling app in one transaction. Preserve record IDs and create fresh versions. Validate every line, schema, uniqueness and quota. Existing IDs conflict; any failed line rolls back the upload. A line must be a single UTF-8 JSON object. No blank lines.

summary: List the caller's pending group tasks
description: Return each eligible parallel task separately. The verified group path must match the task's unit and one of its candidate groups. All filters narrow that authorized set. Each request scans at most 20 Flowable pages of 100 active tasks in task ID order before applying the unit, candidate-group and overdue filters. The optional definitionKey narrows the engine scan. The cursor paginates the scanned set. overdue is true if dueAt is past at response time. Sort by deadline ascending with undated tasks last, then taskId. claimedBy and claimedUntil describe the active claim and are both null when the task is unclaimed or the claim has expired.

schema.description: Opaque cursor. Reuse with the same filters and sort.

queryParameters.name: candidateGroup
queryParameters.description: Optional task group filter. It cannot grant access to a group.

description: An eligible member of a candidate group in the task unit may claim the task. The claim expires after 1800 seconds by default and may last up to 28800 seconds. Repeating a claim as the current holder returns the existing expiry without extending it. A claim held by another caller or a completed task returns 409. Core serializes claims and releases with completion. An accepted completion in progress prevents a new claim.
An eligible current holder may release their claim. Repeating release while the waiting task is unclaimed returns 204. An active claim of another caller or an already completed task returns 409.

Read completed steps newest first by completedAt and taskId. Access requires a verified group eligible on the execution or an enrolled audit.read principal. Core stamps the actor and the matching group used for authorization. If several groups match, use the first in the definition's candidateGroups order. Pending transitions are absent. Verified checkpoints and executions without task policy or user tasks return an empty page.

summary: Create or replace a directory member
description: An enrolled directory administrator sets the desired state at the named key. The OIDC login subject must already exist in the tenant. The groups array replaces that unit's group assignments and accepts only existing groups in that unit. Success confirms synchronization with the identity provider. Retry the same desired state if synchronization is unavailable. Previously issued tokens can retain old claims until renewed.

Deleting membership removes all of the member's group assignments in this unit. Repeating a successful deletion returns 204. Success confirms synchronization with the identity provider. Retry the same desired state if synchronization is unavailable. Previously issued tokens can retain old claims until renewed.

summary: Search readable records and clean text files
description: Search registered searchable record fields and text extracted from clean files. Core applies live tenant, ownership and exact read-share checks before returning results. Sensitive field matches are excluded for management viewers. Results contain references only. Order by relevance with a stable resource ID tie-breaker. Index updates are asynchronous.

description: Connect with the Authorization bearer header. Receive new workflow tasks for eligible groups, record status changes for readable records and consent revocations for the subject or affected app. Each SSE event has a named event field and one JSON data line containing references only. The connection is live-only and has no event IDs or replay. Reconnect and refresh source lists after disconnect. Core closes the stream when authentication expires and rechecks authorization before delivery.
Dependency check, not transaction success or full DR. Other methods return 404.

Prometheus text format 0.0.4 with request counters by method, route family and status, cumulative request duration and process uptime/memory gauges. Unauthenticated by design because Prometheus cannot speak OIDC; reachable only on the internal monitoring network and never proxied by the gateway. Query strings are ignored and other methods return 405 with Allow: GET.

summary: Get the caller's verified subject and organization context
description: subjectId is optional and comes from the verified token claim of a bound data-subject account. It is distinct from the login subject. units, unitPaths and groups reflect verified provider membership and are restricted to the effective unit for app-scoped bearers. unitPaths entries pair an ID with its full /tenant/unit provider group path. Group paths have the form /unit/group.

summary: Exchange a user's login token for a delegated Core bearer
description: Authenticate as an active deployed application's enrolled service account. Send a user access token issued to that same client and tenant. Core validates the current user assignment and pins its selected unit. The result carries the user's sub and application's act, expires within 60 seconds and within both input token lifetimes, and has no refresh token. Each delegated request checks Keycloak, deployment and assignment again. Write access requires both input tokens to carry core-writer and the current app role to allow the operation.

Without sort, use the existing (created_at, id) order. Supply nextCursor with unchanged owner, filters and ordering. Core applies the collection’s field masking policy to all returned records. Management readers also omit schema-sensitive fields without masking rules. Fields with masking rules are excluded from filtering and sorting for all readers. Shared reads include only live exact shares and live app-group shares with current membership. Missing or inaccessible owner scope returns 404. In compatibility mode, a list without the new filter parameters may retain the legacy body and cursor without version fields.

description: Only the owner app writes. Validate data against the registered schema, if any, and enforce the unique field and collection quota. Compact UTF-8 JSON in data is limited to 64 KiB across write endpoints. New records start at version 1. An Idempotency-Key enables the versioned response. A server in compatibility mode also accepts requests without the key and returns the legacy body with an ETag. Strict mode requires the key.

headerParameters.name: Idempotency-Key
headerParameters.description: UUID required in strict mode. With a key, an identical request replays its original response within 24 hours.

description: Returns the current representation. An owner receives the strong ETag to use on a subsequent write. Existing records start at version 1. Core applies the collection’s field masking policy to the authorized reader. Management readers also omit schema-sensitive fields without masking rules. Strict mode includes version in the response body. Compatibility mode retains the legacy body. Shared and management reads omit the write ETag. An exact GET using a delegated token can also use a current resource consent for the selected unit. A matching revoked or expired consent returns 403 with consent_revoked or consent_expired and requestId when ordinary read authority is absent.

summary: Replace record data or increment numeric fields
description: The data form replaces the complete data object and checks schema and uniqueness. The operations form is the only edit that may omit If-Match, because it updates server-side without a client read. An If-Match supplied with operations must still match. An Idempotency-Key is required for operations. A lock held by a different caller blocks either form. An increment uses the current value of a declared top-level numeric indexed field. by, min and max are numbers. Bounds are optional and inclusive, and min must be at most max. A nonnumeric or absent value, an ineligible field or inverted bounds returns 400. Process increments in array order and apply them together in one database statement. A bound failure returns 409 with limit_exceeded and the field name. A successful write increments the record version once and validates the resulting data against the collection schema. Strict mode requires If-Match for replacements. Compatibility mode accepts its omission and preserves the legacy replacement body. An atomic increment always returns a versioned body.

headerParameters.name: If-Match
headerParameters.description: Send the exact strong ETag from the record response. Required when the request replaces existing data. Atomic increments and creation by unique key may omit it. If supplied, a missing or stale record version returns 412.

headerParameters.name: Idempotency-Key
headerParameters.description: Required when the PATCH body contains operations. The planned Idempotency-Key replay and 24-hour retention rules apply when a key is supplied.

description: In strict mode the owner must supply If-Match for every existing record, including in schemaless collections and while holding the record lock. A missing required tag or stale tag leaves the record unchanged. A lock held by a different caller prevents deletion. Compatibility mode accepts an omitted If-Match.

summary: Acquire or renew a record lock
description: The owner app may acquire an exclusive lock for 300 seconds by default, up to 1800 seconds per request. Core binds the lock to the verified app and, when present, its verified delegated user. To renew an active lock, send its lockId in the body and a fresh Idempotency-Key. Renewal sets the expiry relative to the renewal time and retains the lockId. Acquiring without lockId while already holding the active lock returns that lock without extending it. A stale lockId returns 409 resource_conflict. A lock held by another caller returns 423. Core checks the active lock in the same transaction as each record mutation. Locks expire automatically and leave the record ETag unchanged.

headerParameters.name: Idempotency-Key
headerParameters.description: Required UUID for this write. A missing or malformed key returns 400 invalid_request. Core retains the first recorded result for 24 hours, scoped to the verified tenant and caller, HTTP method and concrete request path. Within that window, the same key and logical request replay the first status, body and resource headers without another write. A changed body or write precondition for the same key returns 422 idempotency_key_reused. Concurrent identical requests share one result; every replay requires current authorization.

description: Only the holder of the active lock may release it, using the exact Lock-Id. Administrators cannot force release. If the record exists and has no active lock, return 204. An active lock held by another caller returns 423. An active lock held by this caller with a different lockId returns 409 resource_conflict.

headerParameters.name: Lock-Id
headerParameters.description: The lockId from the active lock response.

summary: Upload an object with optional metadata
description: The file part must be 1 byte–5 MiB and is published only after a clean scan. A recordRef may point to a live record owned by the caller. The link and tags confer no read access. Charge the bytes of current published objects to the per-app quota before publication. Replacement charges the size delta; deletion releases the current size. The octet-stream form creates an unlinked and untagged object. For multipart uploads the logical request includes file bytes, link and tags. Multipart boundaries are transport framing and do not change the logical request. While any published version's byte size is still unmeasured by the internal reconciliation task, uploads answer 503 quota_unmeasured instead of charging an incomplete sum; a version whose bytes no longer exist stays uncounted. The listing hides a version until its size is measured. A commit whose staged upload attempt was invalidated by the internal reconciliation worker answers 409 staging_conflict; retry the upload with a fresh idempotency key.

headerParameters.name: Idempotency-Key
headerParameters.description: With a key, an identical request replays its original response within 24 hours.

summary: List authorized objects by record or tag
description: Return current clean object metadata readable with existing ownership or exact share grants. Match both filters when supplied. Use recordRef[collection] and recordRef[id] together. Sort by object ID. Record links alone never grant visibility. A version whose size is still unmeasured by the internal reconciliation task stays hidden from the listing until it is measured; while any version of the caller's app is unmeasured, uploads answer 503 quota_unmeasured.

For an existing object, omitted metadata preserves the previous value. Use null to clear recordRef and [] to clear tags. A new object defaults to no link or tags. For multipart uploads the logical request includes file bytes, link and tags. Multipart boundaries are transport framing and do not change the logical request. A commit whose staged upload attempt was invalidated by the internal reconciliation worker answers 409 staging_conflict; retry the upload with a fresh idempotency key.

description: Active registered backend resolved from verified tenant/issuer/client_id and exact operator-enrolled resource_subject. Owner-only mutations; individually shared reads. Suspension/revocation and disabled enrollment block access. Upload 1 byte to 5 MiB. Stable-UUID PUT with identical bytes is retryable; POST creates a new ID and is not blindly retried. V2 DELETE tombstones permanently; bytes/old versions retained. PUT publishes immutable versions after DB reauthorization; concurrent owner PUTs use last publication. UUIDs are tenant-scoped, so a foreign tenant may create independent bytes at the same UUID. An exact GET using a delegated token can also use a current resource consent for the selected unit. A matching revoked or expired consent returns 403 with consent_revoked or consent_expired and requestId when ordinary read authority is absent.

summary: Share a resource with an app or a record with an app group
description: Use granteeAppId for an exact app recipient or granteeAppGroup for one same-tenant operator-managed app label. A group share applies to one record and expires within 24 hours, like an exact app share. Active membership is checked at read time; expiry, revocation or app suspension terminates subsequent reads. Existing revoke-by-shareId also revokes group shares. Shares grant no write or onward grant authority. A supplied Idempotency-Key replays the original share instead of creating another.

headerParameters.name: Idempotency-Key
headerParameters.description: Supply a stable UUID for replay safety. Existing exact-app shares remain accepted without it in compatibility mode.

While an accepted completion is pending, cancellation conflicts.
